lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Jacksonville Jaguars −10.5 with a fair total of 48.0, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Jacksonville Jaguars pass offence vs Indianapolis Colts pass defence, which sits +0.240 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
